chunks: Ibn Muskan narrated from Abu Basir, who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah عليه السلام: "A man appoints someone to slaughter on his behalf, while he himself discards his hair in Mecca." He said: "He is not permitted to discard his hair except in Mina."

key_terms.بِمِنًى: in Mina, the prescribed location mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.شَعْرَهُ: his hair, referring to ritual hair removal or discarding it
key_terms.لَيْسَ لَهُ: it is not permitted for him
key_terms.يُوصِي: appoints or instructs someone to act on his behalf

ai.seo_question: If someone appoints another person to perform the slaughter for him in hajj, may he discard his hair in Mecca?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling related to the rites of hajj, specifically regarding where a person may discard his hair after arranging for slaughter on his behalf. It indicates that even in such a case, the hair may only be discarded in Mina, underscoring adherence to the prescribed ritual location.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3090 - Ibn Muskan narrated from Abu Basir, who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah (as): "A man instructs someone to slaughter on his behalf while he discards his hair in Mecca."
Imam (as) replied: "He is not permitted to discard his hair except in Mina."
